proposed_fixes.root_cause: FancyZones may not classify a detached chart as an eligible top-level drag target; the report lacks details to confirm.
plan: Identify chart application and affected window ownership/type.
Compare its Shift-drag with a normal top-level window.
If a legitimate top-level window is excluded, adjust only that rule and add a focused regression.

issue_context.summary: A Korean report says FancyZones does not activate layout zones when moving selected stock-chart windows while holding Shift.
known_information: Report is PowerToys 0.86.0 from Microsoft Store.
Reporter says some detached chart windows moved separately do not activate zones on Shift-drag.
No comments or reproduction image are present.
inferences: The chart may be a child, tool, or custom-framed window that FancyZones classifies differently from a normal top-level window; app and window type are unknown.
issue_context.analysis: The chart application and whether this is a normal title-bar drag determine whether the cause is target eligibility or input. Do not broaden support for popup windows without that evidence.
initial_investigation: Current FancyZones drag state consumes Shift/mouse input; target eligibility is a separate path. src/modules/fancyzones/FancyZonesLib/DraggingState.cpp.

information_gaps.information: Chart application/version, whether the affected chart is top-level or popup/child, and exact current-release drag sequence.
information_gaps.why_needed: FancyZones handles window types differently; this identifies target eligibility versus Shift/mouse input.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Name the chart app, detach a chart, then state whether you drag its title bar while holding Shift and whether zones appear.

actions.label: Request chart window type and drag steps

comment.body: Thanks for describing that some detached chart windows fail to activate FancyZones while Shift-dragging. The chart application and window type are missing, and those details determine whether this is window eligibility or drag input. Please identify the chart app/version and whether the affected window is a detached top-level window or popup/child, and confirm whether the same sequence still fails on current PowerToys.
